stage0032_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...The one arrested at Narita Airport,
　did they show that reaction?」

stage0032_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Yes.
　He suddenly attacked an airport worker and
　tried to strangle them, so we ran a drug test...」

stage0032_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Traces of T1971 turned up in his blood.」

stage0032_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That boy... $$クガヤマ・タクマ$$, is highly
　likely to have undergone adjustment to
　control a Lambda Driver.」

stage0032_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「That's why we asked you to come all this
　way so early, Colonel.」

stage0032_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It's fine.
　Judging by the Hanka Autonomous Region battle,
　a $$ウィスパード$$ is almost certainly among our enemies.」

stage0032_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Tracking Lambda Driver users and developers
　is one of $$ミスリル$$'s top strategic priorities.」

stage0032_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「I never imagined we'd obtain a clue
　like this in such a manner.」

stage0032_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Tonight at 《$$スウィート・ウォーター$$》, the $$大統領$$ and
　Neo Zeon's $$ハマーン・カーン$$ will hold talks...」

stage0032_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Facing the world's turning point,
　various organizations are on the move.」

stage0032_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
Trooper
「Excuse me.
　We've brought in $$クガヤマ・タクマ$$.」

stage0032_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Interrogation revealed he belongs to
　an organization called A21.」

stage0032_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$テッサ$$
「A21... That's not a name I recognize.」

stage0032_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Please be careful, Colonel.
　He's already showing side effects like
　violent outbursts and memory loss.」

stage0032_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...He's guilty, I'd say.
　Just my hunch, though.」

stage0032_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$テッサ$$
「If that's the case, then a Lambda
　Driver-equipped weapon made for him
　is somewhere here in Japan...」

stage0032_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「A tremor from below...!?
　Did they blow the bunker!?」

stage0032_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「They struck where we couldn't see...!?」

stage0032_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Colonel, get away from the window!」

stage0032_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Don't tell me... they've come to reclaim
　$$タクマ$$!? Then we need to move him from here!」

stage0032_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Alright, let me formally introduce her
　to everyone! This is $$ユノハ・スルール$$, an Element!」

stage0032_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$桂$$
「Cute girls are always welcome.
　Nice to meet you too.」

stage0032_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$アマタ$$
「This is $$ユノハ$$'s Element ability.」

stage0032_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ルカ$$
「I see... So this power was the truth
　behind the vanishing transfer student.」

stage0032_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「I... couldn't fit in with school life,
　and so... I wished I could just disappear...」

stage0032_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「But... seeing $$シンジ$$, I thought I
　needed to change too...」

stage0032_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Yes.
　Seeing $$シンジ$$ work so hard gave me courage.
　So...」

stage0032_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Way to go, $$シンジ$$. You really raised
　your stock with Operation Yashima.」

stage0032_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$桂$$
「True enough.
　No wonder she's got a fan.」

stage0032_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Hang in there, $$ユノハ$$.
　We're all going to be working together
　from here on out.」

stage0032_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Just relax.
　Everyone here's pretty easygoing.」

stage0032_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$シュレード$$
「$$アマタ$$, $$アルト$$... you two should step back.」

stage0032_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$シュレード$$
「Heh... an unwitting heartbreaker is
　the hardest thing to deal with.」

stage0032_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「If you don't get it, that's fine.
　Once you start noticing things like that,
　you'll become my biggest rival.」

stage0032_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$クラン$$
「Quit talking nonsense, $$ミシェル$$!
　Now then, off to school after a while!」

stage0032_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Huh... so that's what was really going
　on behind that blackout the other day...」

stage0032_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アルト$$
「I wish $$かなめ$$ could've seen it too.
　$$シンジ$$'s big moment.」

stage0032_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$甲児$$
「And on top of that, surviving that crisis
　brought $$シンジ$$ and $$レイ#333$$ real close.」

stage0032_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Well, good work out there, anyway.」

stage0032_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But since nobody contacted us, covering
　for you with the teachers wasn't easy.」

stage0032_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$アルト$$
「Hold on a second.
　I asked someone to properly tell $$かなめ$$
　that I'd be skipping school.」

stage0032_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$n
「I heard that too.
　I'm pretty sure contacting Miss Chidori
　was left to $$宗介$$.」

stage0032_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You... don't tell me you completely forgot?」

stage0032_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Does that include our promise too?」

stage0032_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Right, it's a fight to save the
　world, after all... A promise with me
　must seem so small next to that...」

stage0032_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$宗介$$
「It's not that I'm following...
　I'm just heading to school too...」

stage0032_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「No use chasing her, $$宗介$$.
　When a girl's blood is boiling,
　no amount of apologizing helps.」

stage0032_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$n
「I'll find a chance to apologize
　for you too. Don't do anything rash.」

stage0032_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$甲児$$
「By the way, what was that promise
　with $$かなめ$$? A date, maybe?」

stage0032_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$宗介$$
「It wasn't anything of that sort.
　I was to be treated to dinner and
　tutored in Japanese history, my weak subject.」

stage0032_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Guess there's another unwitting one here...」

stage0032_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$アルト$$
「Forgetting to call is one thing,
　but standing her up is bad news...」

stage0032_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$n
「Sorry, $$宗介$$.
　I said I'd smooth things over earlier,
　but I'm calling that off.」

stage0032_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Come on, $$カレン$$.
　Eat up, eat up...!」

stage0032_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$カレン$$
「Dashimaki eggs, chawanmushi, fried chicken,
　nikujaga, salad, shumai, and even
　takikomi rice on top... What a feast.」

stage0032_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It's stuff I had frozen and thawed out,
　but the taste's solid, I promise.」

stage0032_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's where you say it's so mellow...」

stage0032_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...So, feeling a bit better now?」

stage0032_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It's just... $$カレン$$... when I saw you
　after so long, you seemed down...」

stage0032_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$カレン$$
「Thanks...
　So that's why you invited me to dinner.」

stage0032_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「If something happened, talk to me.
　Even I can manage just listening.」

stage0032_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$カレン$$
「Hey, $$かなめ$$...
　why are guys so selfish like that...」

stage0032_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$カレン$$
「Disappearing off without a word,
　then showing up out of nowhere
　and leaving again without saying anything...」

stage0032_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Uh... um... that is...
　do you like that person, $$カレン$$?」

stage0032_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$カレン$$
「I don't know... There was a time
　I hated him enough to want to kill him...」

stage0032_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$かなめ$$
（N-no good...
　I'm bad at ordinary romance advice already,
　let alone grown-up relationship talk...)

stage0032_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$カレン$$
「After eating $$かなめ$$'s good cooking,
　moping about it just felt stupid.
　I'm done thinking about it.」

stage0032_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「O-oh...
　Glad I could help, then,
　ha, hahahaha.」

stage0032_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$カレン$$
「Hey... is there anyone you like, $$かなめ$$?」

stage0032_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「A sudden switch of offense and defense!?」

stage0032_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$カレン$$
「The volunteer club's got more guys.
　Isn't there one you think is nice?」

stage0032_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Hmm... the guys in our club really
　are popular with the girls...」

stage0032_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Not to mention drop-dead gorgeous $$アルト$$,
　cheerful, all-around athlete $$甲児$$,
　attentive, gentlemanly $$ミシェル$$...」

stage0032_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Rich-boy cutie $$ルカ$$, and even the
　Element kids who barely show up to school
　each seem to have their own fans...」

stage0032_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh right, the little kids are popular too!
　That energetic troublemaker and serious
　short-pants duo are a hit with some fans.」

stage0032_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$シンジ$$'s a bit shy too, but I guess
　that type stirs up the maternal instinct,
　because he's surprisingly popular.」

stage0032_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$n's got a lot of hardcore fans too.
　Some girls say his wild, brooding side
　is just too much to handle.」

stage0032_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It's not really 'brooding,'
　he's just blunt and bad with words.」

stage0032_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$カレン$$
「You're so frustrating!
　What about $$宗介$$, huh!?」

stage0032_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$カレン$$
「I know, you know.
　This feast, you actually made it
　for $$宗介$$, didn't you?」

stage0032_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's...!
　If I don't watch him, all he eats is
　Calorie Friend bars and dried meat!」

stage0032_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$カレン$$
「Ahh, I'm stuffed.
　Even I can't eat any more than this.」

stage0032_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$カレン$$
「But it'd be a waste to leave it...
　Hey, why not give it to someone nearby?」

stage0032_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Ah... um... about this morning...
　I've got... you know... a stubborn streak...」

stage0032_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I heard from $$カレン$$ that it was...
　a really tough mission...
　so, well... what I mean is...」

stage0032_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$宗介$$
「No... I'm always causing you trouble.
　If you apologize, that puts me in a bind.」

stage0032_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$宗介$$
「There's nothing to forgive.
　The fault is mine.」

stage0032_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Thanks, Sousuke.
　So, um... you haven't had dinner yet, right?
　If you want, why not eat this?」

stage0032_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$宗介$$
「N-no...
　I'll just take the thought.」

stage0032_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$カレン$$
「What's wrong?
　$$かなめ$$ came all this way to see you...」

stage0032_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$宗介$$
「The circumstances are highly complex
　and organic. Explaining will take time,
　and I'm not confident you'd accept it.」

stage0032_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Sagara... um... do you have a T-shirt or
　something? I can't stay in just a towel.」

stage0032_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$宗介$$!
　What kind of guy are you, huh!!」

stage0032_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What a cute girlfriend.
　Sorry to intrude.」

stage0032_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sorry.
　I butted in blind. That must've bothered you.」

stage0032_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$宗介$$
「Like I said before.
　This is Captain $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$...」

stage0032_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$宗介$$
「My superior officer, and
　captain of $$ミスリル$$'s West Pacific fleet's
　assault landing sub, $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.」

stage0032_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$カレン$$
「So, chased by that A21 terror group,
　you hid that $$タクマ$$ kid in your room,
　her subordinate and all... is that it?」

stage0032_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$.
　My friends call me $$テッサ$$, though...」

stage0032_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Look, I watch movies like that too...
　a 'captain' is supposed to have a beard
　and be some cool, grizzled old man!」

stage0032_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$かなめ$$
「A kid like her should be some lowly extra
　reading off messages, that's just how it is!」

stage0032_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$カレン$$
「Hey, you... stand up for a second.」

stage0032_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$カレン$$
「S-sorry!
　But I just startled you, I didn't hit you!」

stage0032_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Y-yes...!
　But you startled me, and I fell over...」

stage0032_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$カレン$$
「...After a scene like that,
　there's no way you're really $$ミスリル$$ military, right?」

stage0032_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$宗介$$
（Tch...
　Guess only a few staff officers within $c
　even know about the Colonel...)

stage0032_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sousuke!
　I don't care one bit what kind of
　relationship you have with this girl!」

stage0032_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But! Isn't there such a thing as honor!?
　Who tells a lie this obvious, seriously!?」

stage0032_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Colonel...?
　Oh, you mean me, right?
　What is it?」

stage0032_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'd like the Colonel to explain it to them too...」

stage0032_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Oh, um... I'm the captain of...
　an 'assault'... submarine, was it?
　And a colonel, and $$宗介$$'s superior, right?」

stage0032_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes, it's true, $$千鳥かなめ$$.」

stage0032_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$カレン$$
「You blew it completely, $$宗介$$.
　Next time, coach her better.」

stage0032_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$宗介$$
「Awake now, $$クガヤマ・タクマ$$?」

stage0032_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Been awake for a while now.
　Thanks to that girl's shrill voice,
　it was the worst wake-up call.」

stage0032_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You've got this subtle smirk going on,
　and it's kind of, I don't know, irritating.」

stage0032_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$カレン$$
「Keep quiet for a bit, you.
　Don't you get what your position is?」

stage0032_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Of course I understand,
　Captain $$紅月カレン$$.」

stage0032_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Of course.
　Even without meeting, you were our commander.」

stage0032_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$タクマ$$
「That's right.
　We, A21, were members of the Black Knights.」

stage0032_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Looks like you're awake, $$ミスリル$$'s major?」

stage0032_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「How do you know that?」

stage0032_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$セイナ$$
「We've got a decent intelligence network too.」

stage0032_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「I see...
　A terror group at your level owning a
　Lambda Driver unit means you've got backing.」

stage0032_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$セイナ$$
「I'll leave that to your imagination.」

stage0032_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Why did you save me?」

stage0032_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$セイナ$$
「I wanted to talk with you,
　$$ミスリル$$'s capable commander.」

stage0032_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Slipping past our watch and pulling off
　an ambush, you seem quite the capable leader.」

stage0032_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Heh... thank you.
　But that tactic was our leader's specialty.」

stage0032_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$セイナ$$
「The ground giving way beneath you is
　an instinctive human fear, they say.」

stage0032_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「...You belonged to the Black Knights?」

stage0032_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Correct.
　$$ゼロ$$'s tactics seem to be famous.」

stage0032_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Though our A21 wasn't a group
　he organized directly.」

stage0032_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Well-read major, have you ever
　heard the name Seiji Takechi?」

stage0032_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$セイナ$$
「A Japanese mercenary who roamed war zones
　worldwide. Well, 《$$新日本$$》, that is.」

stage0032_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「I see...
　So that's why you joined the Black Knights.」

stage0032_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Seiji Takechi left occupied $$新日本$$,
　gathering kids likewise driven from
　their homeland, and dropouts from society.」

stage0032_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$セイナ$$
「That was the seed of our A21...
　He forged us, who'd lost our homeland,
　through Spartan discipline, into soldiers.」

stage0032_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Mind control, dressed up as education...」

stage0032_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$セイナ$$
「That's not it.
　He gave us the confidence to live.」

stage0032_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$セイナ$$
「And so, after the $$破界事変$$,
　$$ゼロ$$'s return let us cross to $$新日本$$...
　《$$エリア１１$$》, and we joined the Black Knights...」

stage0032_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$セイナ$$
「So we could put the skills we'd learned to full use.」

stage0032_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「There were twists and turns, but $$新日本$$ was freed.
　So why do you still carry out acts of terror?」

stage0032_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$セイナ$$
「In a world at peace, we lost our place...
　Ironic, isn't it... we got exactly what
　we wanted so badly, after all.」

stage0032_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$セイナ$$
「All that was left was emptiness...
　Society had no place for us, and unable
　to fit into peace, the world cast us out.」

stage0032_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$セイナ$$
「On top of that, Seiji Takechi, who saved our
　homeland, was branded a terrorist for turning
　children into soldiers... no place even in $$新日本$$.」

stage0032_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$セイナ$$
「In the end, all he could do was die in despair...」

stage0032_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「...The reality returning soldiers face, huh...」

stage0032_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Those of us left behind had nowhere to go...
　The only place we ended up was one where our
　training was useful... the battlefield.」

stage0032_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$セイナ$$
「And our rage at an unjust world
　turned A21 into a terrorist group.」

stage0032_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「And the result is revenge on Japan?」

stage0032_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Even with our grudges, we couldn't bring
　ourselves to touch the $$新日本$$ we took back.」

stage0032_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$セイナ$$
「So we made this side's Japan our target.
　...Wrap this country, which has always known
　peace, in flame, and show it our hell...」

stage0032_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$セイナ$$
「If that feeling counts as revenge, then yes.
　Destroy it all, let flames of terror devour
　the city whole... that's what I want.」

stage0032_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「In the state I'm in, you think I could manage that?」

stage0032_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$セイナ$$
「You won't die just yet.
　You seem the gentleman type, but tough first...」

stage0032_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「True enough.
　Unlike this Takechi fellow, I'm tough
　enough not to give up on surviving.」

stage0032_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「That's your own problem.
　Your teacher, Seiji Takechi, exists only in you.」

stage0032_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Your conduct decides what's true of him.
　That's all there is to it.」

stage0032_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Strange man...
　More clergy than warrior.
　A Bible would suit you well, I bet.」

stage0032_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「An attractive career change, that...」

stage0032_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「It's not too late yet.」

stage0032_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$セイナ$$
「No... you were my enemy from the start.
　Not killing you was only a whim.」

stage0032_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$宗介$$
「...So $$クガヤマ・タクマ$$ had a transmitter
　planted inside his body...」

stage0032_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$カレン$$
「That's a trick we used a lot in the Black
　Knights. Plant an obvious transmitter
　separately, and they're satisfied checking that.」

stage0032_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'm heading out to scout the area.
　I'll leave this to you, Kozuki.」

stage0032_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$宗介$$
「A rescue team from $c will be here soon.
　Hold out until then, and we've won.」

stage0032_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$カレン$$
「All that's left is to wait for it...」

stage0032_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Too bad.
　If not for Captain Kozuki, my comrades
　would've stormed that room in the building.」

stage0032_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$タクマ$$
「It's not too late, Captain.
　Won't you join A21?」

stage0032_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$カレン$$
「Besides, the Black Knights aren't
　terrorists. If you take pride in the fight
　to free $$新日本$$, then you should quit this.」

stage0032_03:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$タクマ$$
「My sister used to say pride like
　that isn't worth a thing.」

stage0032_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's enough backtalk.
　I broke the transmitter you were relying on.」

stage0032_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm amazed...
　Destroying a transmitter embedded in an arm
　instantly, with a microwave oven's waves.」

stage0032_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It's a lot quicker than cutting
　it out with a scalpel.」

stage0032_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$テッサ$$
（This way of thinking...
　So, Kaname really is...）

stage0032_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But I'm sorry, $$テッサ$$...
　For doubting you were the colonel...」

stage0032_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「No, it's fine.
　I'm at fault too, for putting on an act
　that invited the misunderstanding.」

stage0032_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But why would you do something like that...?」

stage0032_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I just wanted to tease you a little.
　You're always with Sergeant Sagara, so...」

stage0032_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$カレン$$
「Hmm... I see how it is...」

stage0032_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Captain Kozuki...
　That expression doesn't suit you.」

stage0032_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$タクマ$$
「No matter what, you ought to be
　burning with rage, glaring at your foes.」

stage0032_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$カレン$$
「Whatever face I make
　is my own business!」

stage0032_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$タクマ$$
「You used to soar across the battlefield
　stronger than anyone. For you to go soft like
　this... my sister would be sad too, I bet...」

stage0032_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$カレン$$
「We fought for peace!
　What's wrong with enjoying it!」

stage0032_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Then tell me!
　How should we have lived in a peaceful world!」

stage0032_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$タクマ$$
「You can't answer, can you...!
　That's right! Since nobody ever taught us,
　we started taking revenge on the world!」

stage0032_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$カレン$$
「So that's the reason for your terrorism...」

stage0032_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Do you have an older sister?」

stage0032_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$タクマ$$
「...What is this?
　If it's interrogation, family's beside the point.」

stage0032_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$テッサ$$
「This isn't an interrogation.
　I just wondered what sort of person you are.」

stage0032_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Thanks to you, we're going through all this
　trouble. Humor me with a little chat, won't you?」

stage0032_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...I have one older brother.
　We've drifted apart by now, though...」

stage0032_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I solved Einstein's ten-variable simultaneous
　nonlinear partial differential equations,
　exactly, at age six. My brother did it at four...」

stage0032_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$カレン$$
（No idea, but it sounds impressive, at least.）

stage0032_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I always felt inferior to my brother.」

stage0032_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$タクマ$$
「How did you get along
　with that brother of yours?」

stage0032_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The closest word for it might be 'kept'...
　It may not have been the healthiest
　relationship. ...Feel inferior to your sister too?」

stage0032_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I can sort of tell.
　A hunch, between kindred spirits, maybe.」

stage0032_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$タクマ$$
「...I suppose so.
　Inferiority, maybe.
　I worship my sister, after all...」

stage0032_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
???
「Then I'll take $$タクマ$$ and the two women first.」

stage0032_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$五飛$$
「The area's already surrounded.
　Resistance is futile, $$ヒイロ$$, $$カレン$$.」

stage0032_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$五飛$$!
　Why are you here!?」

stage0032_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$カレン$$... can't you understand
　that their war still hasn't ended?」

stage0032_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$五飛$$
「This is $$ゼロ$$'s sin...
　No, the world's.」

stage0032_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Why didn't you run?
　I said I'd be your shield, and yet...」

stage0032_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Well, that's what you say, but...」

stage0032_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$テッサ$$
「That's right, isn't it...!
　You can't trust the help of such a clumsy,
　athletically hopeless colonel!」

stage0032_03:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Calm down...!
　That's not the only reason.」

stage0032_03:r_e418ba9e04898c28.text:
$$かなめ$$
「He came to Jindai High to protect me,
　right? So he's bound to come help...」

stage0032_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「He's short on common sense, and he forgets
　promises completely, but once he decides
　he'll do something, he does it... I believe that.」

stage0032_03:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「You really trust him, don't you, Sagara...」

stage0032_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「And what about you, Colonel?
　He's your subordinate, isn't he?」

stage0032_03:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...Of course I trust him.
　But not simply as a subordinate...」

stage0032_03:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Building it up just to let me down...」

stage0032_03:r_9bf1948e282e5587.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...Being around you keeps throwing off my pace.」

stage0032_03:r_cb5e5d90104f7a88.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I've done foolish things I'd never
　normally do, again and again this time.
　That prank of mine was one of them.」

stage0032_03:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$かなめ$$
「So, in the end... why do you want to
　tease us when Sousuke and I are together?」

stage0032_03:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Who knows...
　Sure, I'm scared, but how do I put it...
　when it's right there, I want to fight back.」

stage0032_03:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah, there's always some enemy out there
　trying to get me down by picking a fight...
　and when one shows up, I just have to deal with it.」

stage0032_03:r_1de04d77f1060720.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Maybe that's just the mood
　I'm going with, you know?」

stage0032_03:r_5149abbbcbee6ee4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Not really.
　Even I go through stuff the Colonel wouldn't get...」

stage0032_03:r_bedf0f18c13c0a97.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Especially since that Sousuke transferred in,
　things around me got loud all of a sudden.」

stage0032_03:r_56d65b2dba1b5061.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Has Sagara really caused you that much trouble?」

stage0032_03:r_31865d3496c34d8b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Ugh, it's the worst!
　He's got zero sense, always causing some dumb mess...」

stage0032_03:r_7d1683c9b3b3094a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I know he doesn't mean any harm,
　which somehow makes it worse.
　Clumsy but so earnest, I can't just leave him be...」

stage0032_03:r_2249da179abb6501.text:
$$テッサ$$
「He really is strange, isn't he.」

stage0032_03:r_490618028b4c53d6.text:
$$テッサ$$
「But you do trust him, don't you?」

stage0032_03:r_23cb7be357e8a4e0.text:
$$宗介$$
「Are you unharmed!?
　You're not injured!」

stage0032_03:r_d60b2e6806c37bbe.text:
$$宗介$$
「The Colonel is safe as well, I see.」

stage0032_03:r_9d4ee24cdaa2851d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I understand.
　Kaname is a civilian,
　and I'm a soldier.」

stage0032_03:r_003ee7d177c348cf.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Then, Sergeant Sagara...
　prioritize $$千鳥かなめ$$'s escape above all else.
　Begin the operation at once.」

stage0032_03:r_eb4bb0599c61e2b2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Also, it seems Major $$カリーニン$$ is here as well.
　Rescue him too, if possible.」

stage0032_03:r_1a9f38456bfe7b4a.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$宗介$$, I'm leaving the two of them to you.
　I'll hold the enemy here.」

stage0032_03:r_6f761a8fd9d1f7b4.text:
$$宗介$$
「Sorry, $$ヒイロ$$.
　I'm counting on you.」

stage0032_03:r_42d73bcdaedb1371.text:
$$五飛$$
「Stayed behind to let your friends escape.
　Same as always.」

stage0032_03:r_65ef57e28bd90298.text:
$$五飛$$
「Look at those A21 soldiers.
　As long as their fight doesn't end, neither does mine.」

stage0032_03:r_bbc100b0424fdcd0.text:
$$五飛$$
「Get in Zero, $$ヒイロ$$.
　You too should know what lies beyond
　this world's... false peace.」

stage0032_03:r_821a93f3f890d905.text:
$$かなめ$$
「H-hang on!
　This isn't the exit, is it!?」

stage0032_03:r_8cb00be7cca91c45.text:
$$テッサ$$
「There's something I absolutely must
　confirm before we escape.」

stage0032_03:r_01fea60fea66c996.text:
$$かなめ$$
「W-what is this huge thing...!?
　A super robot!?」

stage0032_03:r_48a3f23147fd6b6d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「No...
　It's over 40 meters tall,
　but this is an AS.」

stage0032_03:r_a38016b9c3d59e6e.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Pretty great, huh.
　It's called $$ベヘモス$$.」

stage0032_03:r_9d00ee0ac3902eac.text:
$$セイナ$$
「As expected of that man's subordinate...
　You made it awfully far, didn't you.」

stage0032_03:r_258a09e5e9761e3d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Are you talking about Major $$カリーニン$$?」

stage0032_03:r_263097ee015a04ab.text:
$$セイナ$$
「He got away on his own as well.
　By now, he's likely met up with the other intruder.」

stage0032_03:r_4a301748a7930689.text:
$$テッサ$$
「You people are out of your minds!
　Deploying something like this in a city!」

stage0032_03:r_c38e739de7ee864a.text:
$$タクマ$$
「We're terrorists, you see, Testarossa...
　Personally, it's not like I want to
　gain anything by using this.」

stage0032_03:r_5135fdea02c6bd7b.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Just words, just a statement... nothing more.
　A year from now, most people will
　probably have forgotten about this too.」

stage0032_03:r_c545a5a303470d2c.text:
$$タクマ$$
「But you know, the future doesn't matter.
　I'm a chosen warrior.
　Once I pilot $$ベヘモス$$, it becomes invincible.」

stage0032_03:r_fb06b0a658b1ef40.text:
$$タクマ$$
「I'll destroy a lot, kill a lot.
　That'll make my sister happy, and satisfy me too.」

stage0032_03:r_e5630cc47dc440b7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Stop this, $$タクマ$$!
　You can still turn back, even now!」

stage0032_03:r_8f39e18936c36a15.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Don't call me $$タクマ$$!
　Only my sister gets to call me that!」

stage0032_03:r_ee7f46e6a631fd5c.text:
$$タクマ$$
「Too late, Testarossa...
　I actually kind of liked you...
　but...」

stage0032_03:r_54d7a668750123ea.text:
$$宗介$$
「Got time to chatter with an enemy in front of you?」

stage0032_03:r_dc37213133cd8177.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Sergeant! Take the two of them and fall back!」

stage0032_03:r_c2a5e2a9019026a4.text:
$$セイナ$$
「You really see things through to the end...!」

stage0032_03:r_3c1c81e93f697fb9.text:
$$セイナ$$
「$$タクマ$$, get in $$ベヘモス$$!」

stage0032_03:r_d84831042f10325c.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Don't whine over a scratch like that!」

stage0032_03:r_6a5a0a8d6d6a68fd.text:
$$セイナ$$
「If you don't pilot this thing,
　what value do you even have?
　If you run now, I don't need you at all.」

stage0032_03:r_b0aaf075b2a97a36.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「Have you come to finish me off?」

stage0032_03:r_53add6e443d8a65a.text:
$$セイナ$$
「I don't have time for that.
　Now that we've lost $$ベヘモス$$, we have to
　run and get away.」

stage0032_03:r_d95bdcd1bd8b6579.text:
$$セイナ$$
「I do feel bad for him...
　His memory got twisted, and somewhere along the way
　he started believing I'm the sister he killed...」

stage0032_03:r_2b4d4dced3ef5a03.text:
$$セイナ$$
「I just used it, as it was...
　I don't have any real family...
　I've always been alone...」

stage0032_03:r_4d54e46ed7fd462d.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Talking like you know everything...
　I hate it, it makes me sick.」

stage0032_03:r_1c42d2bca3a5e3a3.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「It's just how I am.」

stage0032_03:r_b23f4e273f76c5a8.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Before we part, will you at least tell me your name?」

stage0032_03:r_2488b984097a7bdf.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「$$アンドレイ・セルゲイヴィッチ・カリーニン$$」

stage0032_03:r_6acc4cacd2cf56b6.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Weird name...
　Heh... let's meet again sometime...」

stage0032_03:r_0491c741ae20f5e6.text:
$$カリーニン$$
「A twisted world... is it...」

stage0032_03:r_60e8a3284b8a113b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「You haven't lost.
　It's just, things like this happen...」

stage0032_03:r_e745974656b70e6a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「You're right, it's a cruel thing.」

stage0032_03:r_d4f3fe1e9bcf2590.text:
$$テッサ$$
「It's all right, $$タクマ$$.
　I'm here.」

stage0032_03:r_3888ccd5f98dd99d.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I'll always be by your side...」

stage0032_03:r_95ef381ed0b96982.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...He fought for his sister until the very end...」

stage0032_03:r_82218191e135e576.text:
$$かなめ$$
「At the end, he thought $$テッサ$$ was his sister...」

stage0032_03:r_46c21ad643c64977.text:
$$カレン$$
「...I won't accept people like them...
　Fighting without anything to believe in,
　anything worth protecting or being proud of...」

stage0032_03:r_6a27ef5c3933ffa2.text:
$$カレン$$
「That's why I fight.
　So the will of those who fought as the
　Black Knights won't be wasted.」

stage0032_03:r_04169fb070591784.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$カレン$$... that goes for me too...
　No, everyone fighting with $c as well.」

stage0032_03:r_1be6bea3e5d25074.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$かなめ$$, $$カレン$$... thank you both.
　Thanks to you, we managed to stop the
　terrorism with minimal damage.」

stage0032_03:r_2471e14c1ef0ecac.text:
$$カレン$$
「Good work to you too, Captain Testarossa.」

stage0032_03:r_6c3c0ada303bce08.text:
$$テッサ$$
「You can just call me $$テッサ$$.
　We're friends now, after all.」

stage0032_03:r_c5d536c5ba8c0902.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$かなめ$$... I owe you special thanks.」

stage0032_03:r_243595675818fcae.text:
$$かなめ$$
「If you mean that, I'd like some explanations.」

stage0032_03:r_ddda297a7997c73b.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm tired too, you know.
　...But may I declare one thing to you?」

stage0032_03:r_fda7edf39e317875.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I think... I've fallen for him.」

stage0032_03:r_b267a0ec877acc0e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Wha...! What!?
　Him... you don't mean...!」

stage0032_03:r_62e68b17a29fb53b.text:
$$カレン$$
「Bold!
　A love declaration of war!!」

stage0032_03:r_3f09ae47d355cbc5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Wait, $$カレン$$!
　Declaration of war...!?」

stage0032_03:r_629b0e87b7bc7b76.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Well, let's just say good luck to us both,
　$$かなめ$$.」

stage0032_03:r_98e716ed18b1b3a2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Ah... good work to you too, Sagara.」

stage0032_03:r_91a4ece3cc02badd.text:
$$宗介$$
「Forgive the interruption, ma'am!
　An emergency has occurred at $$スウィート・ウォーター$$!」

stage0032_03:r_e83ac0db54ff2b02.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$スウィート・ウォーター$$... isn't that...」

stage0032_03:r_bc5b33fbc100b97b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Where the Earth Federation $$大統領$$ and the
　Neo Zeon representative are meeting face to face!」

stage0032_03:r_2cd57aac659672dc.text: ～ $$スウィート・ウォーター$$ Summit Venue

stage0032_03:r_017c609cb5528ca1.text:
$$大統領$$
「...Representative $$ハマーン$$... what did you just say?」

stage0032_03:r_984737d2920b03f7.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then let me say it once more, for everyone
　around the world who may be watching this.」

stage0032_03:r_5ce10ef5943775df.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「As of this moment, today,
　I, $$ハマーン・カーン$$, am resigning
　as the representative of Neo Zeon.」

stage0032_03:r_864ee68806b41af1.text:
$$クラウス$$
「Why now, of all times...!?」

stage0032_03:r_f8c886fa821c5334.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「A successor has already been decided.」

stage0032_03:r_2e5685a3629d0a5e.text:
$$ハマーン$$
「Allow me to introduce him.
　Taking my place as the representative of
　Neo Zeon, Supreme Commander $$シャア・アズナブル$$.」

stage0032_03:r_1054a335fa977a7a.text:
$$シャア$$
「I am $$シャア・アズナブル$$, as just introduced.」

stage0032_03:r_1795607640d74fdb.text:
$$シャア$$
「People of the world...
　As the first Supreme Commander of Neo Zeon, I...」

stage0032_03:r_1ce9868e47e05f97.text:
$$シャア$$
「I declare Neo Zeon's independence from the
　Earth Federation, and at the same time, war.」

stage0032_03:r_b302a6e2e0ca76ec.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0032_03:r_e4166e8a5b45cb96.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0032_03:r_bdfc9cb5d9aaf4ce.text: $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room

stage0032_03:r_cb789b091a7a05ca.text: ～ $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ Briefing Room ～

stage0032_03:r_5430d9d76e38cf47.text:
$$バナージ$$
「A declaration of war...
　The Federation and Neo Zeon are going to war...」

stage0032_03:r_1711e6c6939aa411.text:
$$リディ$$
「So this day has finally come...」

stage0032_03:r_63bcb74b5bb605c9.text:
$$シン$$
「$$カミーユ$$!
　If that's $$シャア・アズナブル$$, then that
　means it's Captain $$クワトロ$$!?」

stage0032_03:r_bdf41f6a0fb7b286.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Even through the monitor, I could tell clearly...
　That's... Captain $$クワトロ$$, who fought with us...」

stage0032_03:r_4f838d45a89974f0.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$シャア$$...!
　Is this the answer you chose!」

stage0032_03:r_e18660f45e2bdaae.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Sending a transmission right at this moment,
　you here to rub it in or something?」

stage0032_03:r_c01f3d97d765f442.text:
$$五飛$$
「...In step with Neo Zeon's declaration of war,
　the $$マリーメイア$$ army will drop its forces on
　Brussels, site of the Earth Federation Peace Hall.」

stage0032_03:r_f2a506c32c68b595.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「What significance does that facility have!?」

stage0032_03:r_366eed12d0fa7297.text:
$$五飛$$
「From there, the $$マリーメイア$$ army will
　broadcast a message to the entire world.」

stage0032_03:r_db902169b0ec12e0.text:
$$五飛$$
「Alongside Earth Federation Vice Foreign
　Minister $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$ and $$ナナリー・ヴィ・ブリタニア$$.」

stage0032_03:r_bccb0c4cb58aa146.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$ヒイロ$$, it's time to settle this between us.
　Board Zero and come to where I designate.」

stage0032_03:r_888c0b4c627ecec4.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「The $$マリーメイア$$ army's atmospheric descent
　has been confirmed! Target: likely Brussels!」

stage0032_03:r_0ee1b4c987332e23.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Tch...!
　They were waiting for the Federation to panic
　over Neo Zeon's declaration of war!」

stage0032_03:r_85121e18387bbee9.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well done, Mr. $$赤木$$.
　This time, I got to see a glimpse of the true
　strength of $$２１世紀警備保障$$.」

stage0032_03:r_58b16d8cc9b8a2a5.text:
$$赤木$$
「Odaiba's practically our backyard.
　Of course we get mad when someone trashes it.」

stage0032_03:r_5cf3d385c6d4b8d0.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even so, I was impressed by the excellent
　navigation from everyone in PR Section 2.」

stage0032_03:r_7c9a719cd8f27d1d.text:
$$赤木$$
「While we're out there fighting,
　$$大山$$ and the others handle evacuation
　guidance on $$佐伯$$'s orders.」

stage0032_03:r_808269c7e458f2a5.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's why they can tell which roads are clear
　and which aren't in the blink of an eye.」

stage0032_03:r_f6f98a8ef73d1d43.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see...
　Well then, let me ask you, Mr. $$赤木$$ of
　$$２１世紀警備保障$$. What road should I take?」

stage0032_03:r_3d395121b4205722.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's obvious!
　Straight down the main road, full speed ahead!」

stage0032_03:r_9496bdb991cf236a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thanks for the textbook advice.
　Well then, let's get going... business, business!」

stage0032_03:r_980e935235423ee4.text:
$$赤木$$
「And while you're at it, here's our ad!
　From crime buzzers to $$ヘテロダイン$$ extermination!
　A new-era security firm, $$２１世紀警備保障$$!」
